d: In this video, we are taking a look at the Atomberg Intellon water purifier that does things differently. Most water purifiers use the same RO purification no matter how the input water is. But the Atomberg Intellon changes that with something called Adaptive Flow, which automatically chooses between RO+UV and UF+UV based on the water quality. I explain how this feature works in detail along with other modes, app features and AMC costs. I also compare the ownership cost with the Urban Company Native M2 Pro and Aquaguard Enrich Ritz Pro. Watch the video fully to know everything about it.
